lessonPlan.title: QA — Farm Animals Image Classifications
lessonPlan.weeklyOverview: Disposable Farm Animals fixture proving owner image classifications. Never publish. Never enable customer flags.
lessonPlan.objectives: Prove every Farm Animals image classification scores correctly without false image gaps.
lessonPlan.vocabularyWords: farm, barn, mud, mural, shelter, market, egg, groom
lessonPlan.weeklyMaterials: trays, bins, paint, cardboard, tongs, scarves, books, sorting cards, wash tubs, towels, cups, mats
lessonPlan.familyConnection: Ask which farm animal your child pretended to care for today.

books.title: Big Red Barn
books.author: Margaret Wise Brown
beforeReadingQuestions: What animals live on a farm?
afterReadingQuestions: Which animal would you care for?

songs.title: Old MacDonald
songs.motions: Tap knees for each animal sound.
songs.teacherDirections: Sing slowly and invite animal sounds.

items.title: Farm Animal Discovery Basket
items.objective: Notice farm animal props and words.
items.setup: Place animals in a basket on a low tray.
items.steps: Invite children to explore and name animals.
teacherTips: Model one animal word, then listen.

items.title: Farm Sound & Motion Circle
items.objective: Match animal sounds with simple motions.
items.steps: Sing and move with farm sounds.
teacherTips: Keep motions small for indoor circle.

items.title: Barnyard Movement Trail
items.objective: Move like farm animals along a trail.
items.steps: Hop, crawl, and stomp along the path.
teacherTips: Model one animal walk at a time.

items.title: Where Does It Belong? Farm Sorting
items.objective: Sort farm items into simple groups.
items.steps: Children sort and talk about where items belong.

items.title: Muddy Animals Wash Laboratory
items.objective: Wash muddy animals and notice clean vs muddy.
items.materials:
Tub
Water
Soap
Towels
Plastic animals
Tray
items.setup: Stage a shallow wash tub with towels nearby.
items.steps: Dip muddy animals, wash, and dry.
teacherTips: Keep water shallow and wipe spills.

items.title: Build an Animal Shelter STEM Challenge
items.objective: Build a simple shelter for a farm animal figure.
items.setup: Offer blocks and cardboard on a clear table.
items.steps: Plan, build, and test a small shelter.
teacherTips: Ask what the animal needs to stay dry.

items.title: Preschool Farmers Market
items.objective: Pretend to buy and sell farm foods.
items.steps: Shop, sell, and share farm foods.

items.title: Pretend Milking Fine-Motor Station
items.objective: Squeeze and pour at a pretend milking station.

items.title: From Farm to Table Story Investigation
items.objective: Talk about how food travels from farm to table.
items.setup: Ready the book and discussion cards.
items.steps: Read, pause, and ask farm-to-table questions.

items.title: Egg Collection Counting Challenge
items.setup: Place carton and counters on a tray.

items.title: Collaborative Animal-Track Mural
items.objective: Make animal-track marks on a shared mural.
items.setup: Tape mural paper and stage paint trays.
items.steps: Stamp tracks and talk about animals.

items.title: Grooming and Caring for Animals
items.objective: Practice gentle care motions with animal props.
items.setup: Pass brushes and animals in a circle.
items.steps: Brush gently and use care words.

items.title: Mystery Farm Sound Game
items.steps: Listen, guess, and move like the animal.

items.title: Design Our Class Farm
items.objective: Arrange a class farm map with simple materials.
items.setup: Offer a large paper farm base.
items.steps: Place barns, paths, and animals together.

items.title: Barnyard Story and Movement Celebration
items.objective: Retell favorite farm moments with movement.
items.steps: Share, move, and sing a goodbye farm verse.
